dry_zone_not_watered.title: Zone {zone} is dry and nothing will water it
dry_zone_not_watered.description:
The bucket of zone **{zone}** has been dry for {days} days, and every program that includes it is disabled, suspended or has no enabled schedule.

Turn a program that waters this zone back on, enable one of its schedules, or lift its suspension. The notice clears by itself once the zone is watered or a program covers it again.

weather_silent.title: Sensor group {mapping}: a weather sensor stopped reporting
weather_silent.description:
Nothing has been received for over {hours} hours from: **{sensors}**. The last report was on {since}.

A reading that old is left out of the calculation, so the zones of this sensor group are calculated on what remains, or not at all.

Check the sensor's battery, its connection and its entity in Home Assistant. The notice clears by itself as soon as it reports again.

missing_input.title: Zone {zone}: nothing could be calculated
missing_input.description:
The evapotranspiration of zone **{zone}** could not be calculated because the weather data had no value for: **{missing}**.

Until it does, the zone's deficit does not move and it is not watered, which looks exactly like a zone with no need.

Check that the sensors mapped to those fields are available, or that the weather service still sends them. The issue clears at the next calculation that can be done.

undersized_zone.title: Zone {zone}: one run cannot water what it loses
undersized_zone.description:
The longest run of zone **{zone}** delivers about **{capacity} mm**, but the zone loses about **{need} mm** between two waterings ({days} day(s)). Its deficit will keep growing however long the weather stays as it is.

The cap is the zone's maximum duration. Raise it, give the zone more emitters or a higher throughput, or lower the days between irrigation. If the cap is on purpose, you can ignore this.

throughput_mismatch.title: Zone {zone}: measured flow does not match the configured throughput
throughput_mismatch.description:
Over the last {samples} runs, the flow meter on zone **{zone}** measured about **{measured}** where the zone is configured for **{configured}** - {percentage}% off.

Every irrigation duration is derived from the configured throughput, so they are all off by roughly the same amount.

If the measurement looks right, set the zone's throughput to it. If it does not, check that the meter only counts this zone, and that mains pressure is what you expect. Smart Irrigation never changes the value for you.

zone_not_calculated_no_readings.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no weather readings
zone_not_calculated_no_readings.description:
Zone **{zone}** was not calculated: its sensor group has no readings to calculate from. Until it has, the zone's deficit does not move and it is not watered.

Check that the sensor group has sources and that they report, update the weather data, then calculate the zone. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_no_engine.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no calculation engine
zone_not_calculated_no_engine.description:
Zone **{zone}** has no calculation engine, so it is not calculated and not watered.

Choose how it is calculated on its card in the Zones tab. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_nothing_from_engine.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no evapotranspiration
zone_not_calculated_nothing_from_engine.description:
Zone **{zone}** takes its evapotranspiration from a sensor or a weather service, and its sensor group had none to give. Until it has, the zone is not watered.

Check the sensor that provides the evapotranspiration, or the weather service. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_forecast_without_ser.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: a forecast without a weather service
zone_not_calculated_forecast_without_ser.description:
The calculation engine of zone **{zone}** looks days ahead, which needs a weather service, and none is set up. The zone is not watered until it can be calculated.

Set up a weather service, or set the engine's forecast days to 0. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_error.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: an error
zone_not_calculated_error.description:
The calculation of zone **{zone}** failed: {detail}

The zone is not watered until it can be calculated. If it keeps failing, please open an issue with this message and the diagnostics file. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.

zone_not_calculated_no_sensor_group.title: Zone {zone} cannot be calculated: no sensor group
zone_not_calculated_no_sensor_group.description:
Zone **{zone}** has no sensor group, so there is nothing to calculate it from and it is not watered.

Choose its sensor group on its card in the Zones tab, then calculate the zone. The notice clears by itself at the next calculation that succeeds.
